acceptanceCriteria: seeded [a,b] and [b,c] under an inclusive overlap rule are reported before any run
a test date equal to a sibling's weekly recurrence date in the same tenant is reported
a shared hook that seeds data lists the tests its failure would skip; unresolved validation abstains
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#1196. (1) Validation pre-check: for seed calls whose target validation resolves statically (uniqueness, range overlap, inclusive/exclusive bounds), check literal or derived seed values and report likely rejections. (2) Sibling collision: within a file or shared fixture scope, collect seeded dates, ranges and unique keys per test including expanded recurrences; report overlaps between tests sharing a tenant. (3) Blast radius: list tests a failing shared setup hook would skip. Related: V1-1883 seed parity, V1-1900 data-setup model.
title: GH #1196: test seeds that fail server-side validation or collide with sibling seeds in a shared setup scope
